units.source_text: 当脚板踩上被夜露濡湿的铁楼梯而感到那份冰凉时，她这才意识到排练舞蹈时光着脚，就这样走了出来。

en.t: When the soles of her feet stepped onto the iron stairs damp with night dew and felt their chill, she finally realized that she had come outside just as she was, barefoot from practicing the dance.

units.source_text: 铁楼梯的那份冰凉，将疼痛般的寂寞从脚心传给了她。

en.t: The chill of the iron stairs carried a painful loneliness into her from the soles of her feet.
